appId.description: The Ably application ID which this key is associated with.

name.description: The name for your API key. This is a friendly name for your reference.

status.description: The status of the key. `0` is enabled, `1` is revoked.

key.description: The complete API key including API secret.

capability.description: The capabilities that this key has. More information on capabilities can be found in the Ably capabilities docs.

additionalProperties.description: An array of strings setting the capability operations for the resource.

created.description: Unix timestamp representing the date and time of creation of the key.

modified.description: Unix timestamp representing the date and time of the last modification of the key.
